title: Ex-NFL player and Fox Sports star Mark Sanchez in critical condition after stabbing
summary: Circumstances surrounding attack remain unclear and suspect has been detained, according to WTHR Former NFL quarterback and Fox Sports television star Mark Sanchez is in critical condition after being stabbed late Friday night in downtown Indianapolis, reports TMZ. Police were called shortly after midnight to a location near West Washington Street and North Senate Avenue where two people were injured, one of them now identified as Sanchez. Continue reading...
